subject: Status of DOQTL genome scan model options

messages.author: 2c7106159c8e6d5b
messages.subject: Status of DOQTL genome scan model options
parts:
So, in DOQTL one had the option to choose between fitting a full model (on the 36 possible diplotype states) or an additive haplotype model (estimating effects for founder alleles). I've been looking through the user guide and can't find any information on whether both options remain available in qtl2 (and if so, how to select one vs. the other). Thanks for any help.

David

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Status of DOQTL genome scan model options
parts:
If you call scan1() using the 36-state probabilities as output by calc_genoprob(), you'll be fitting the full model.

If you first convert the 36-state probabilities to allele dosages, using genoprob_to_alleleprob(), and then use those 8-state probabilities in scan1(), you'll be fitting the additive allele model.

karl
